examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A page source with frontmatter, headings, a paragraph with inline code and a link, a list, a note, steps holding a code group, a table and a card group, rendered inside DocProse. The frontmatter is read, not shown.

examples.name: Components
examples.summary: An Alert tag added through the components prop, a changelog entry, and the outline beside the article built from parseDocMarkdown with the same components map.

examples.name: Term
examples.summary: A term in running text written as `<Tooltip title tip href linkLabel>term</Tooltip>`: it keeps a dotted underline, and resting the pointer on it or tabbing to it opens a HoverCard with the definition and one Learn more link. For documentation and long descriptions, never a label (a label takes a `Hint`).
